# Command Reference

Every command follows the same shape:

```bash
aws-cloud-utilities [GLOBAL OPTIONS] COMMAND [SUBCOMMAND] [ARGUMENTS] [OPTIONS]
```

Global options go **before** the command name; command options go after it.

```bash
aws-cloud-utilities --profile production --region eu-west-1 s3 list-buckets --include-size
```

## Output formats

`--output` accepts `table` (default), `json`, `yaml`, and `csv`. It controls what is printed to the
terminal.

```bash
aws-cloud-utilities --output json s3 list-buckets
aws-cloud-utilities --output csv iam list-roles
```

Many commands also take `--output-file`, which is separate: it writes results to disk and infers the
format from the extension (`.json`, `.yaml`, `.csv`). Some commands take `--output-dir` instead,
because they produce many files rather than one.

```bash
# Printed as a table, written to disk as JSON
aws-cloud-utilities s3 list-buckets --output-file buckets.json
```

## Discovering options

The CLI is self-documenting at every level:

```bash
aws-cloud-utilities --help
aws-cloud-utilities s3 --help
aws-cloud-utilities s3 download --help
```

If this documentation ever disagrees with `--help`, `--help` is right. The generated sections of these
pages are built from the same command definitions and checked in CI, so the two should not drift.

## Commands that write or delete

Most commands are read-only. These are not:

| Command | Effect | Guard |
|---|---|---|
| [`s3 nuke-bucket`](s3.md) | Deletes every object, every version, then the bucket | `--dry-run`, `--confirm`, `--download-first` |
| [`s3 delete-versions`](s3.md) | Deletes object versions | `--dry-run`, `--confirm` |
| [`s3 download --delete-after-download`](s3.md) | Deletes objects from S3 after download | none |
| [`logs delete-group`](logs.md) | Deletes a log group and its data | `--confirm` |
| [`logs aggregate --delete-source`](logs.md) | Deletes local source files after aggregating | none |
| [`ecr delete-repository`](ecr.md) | Deletes a repository and its images | `--force`, `--confirm` |
| [`billing cur-delete`](billing.md) | Deletes a Cost and Usage Report | `--confirm` |
| [`cloudfront update-logging`](cloudfront.md) | Modifies every distribution in the account | `--dry-run` |
| [`logs set-retention`](logs.md) | Changes retention; shortening it expires existing data | `--dry-run`, `--if-never` |

Where `--dry-run` exists it prints the full plan without making changes. Use it first.
